subject: seed
$comment: Computed values, made by two independent passes from PUBLIC-SPEC.md section 4, 'Where the seed comes from', alone. METHOD: seed = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(outputSeed, 0))); abi.encode pads both uint256 arguments to 32-byte big-endian words, so the preimage is exactly 64 bytes: outputSeed, then 32 zero bytes. 'preimage' is a second assertion that localises a failure to encoding rather than hashing. Each case exists to fail a specific wrong implementation; see its description. The Chainlink detail behind the formula - that VRFCoordinatorV2_5 derives randomWords[i] as keccak256(abi.encode(randomness, i)) and logs randomness as outputSeed in RandomWordsFulfilled - was read from @chainlink/contracts 1.5.0 source while drafting the prose, before these values were computed. PROVENANCE: Pass A: Claude (an AI), in Python with a generic keccak256 library, no implementation consulted. Claude also drafted part of the prose, so a disagreement was to be read as possible evidence the text is unclear, not only as a miscomputation. Its keccak256 primitive was verified against the published empty-input hash. Pass B, 2026-10-02: a second person, on a separate machine, with no access to this file or to pass A's method or terminal, in JavaScript with ethers v6. All four seeds agreed exactly, and pass B independently described the 64-byte preimage for each, all four matching 'preimage'. Pass B recorded as read from the prose, not decided: argument order (outputSeed, 0); the index as uint256 rather than bytes32, uint8 or omitted; abi.encode rather than abi.encodePacked. Format: vectors/FORMAT.md.

cases.name: zeroOutputSeed
cases.description: outputSeed of zero. The 64-byte preimage is all zeros. Fails an implementation that returns outputSeed unhashed, and one that hashes only the 32-byte outputSeed and omits the index word.

cases.name: oneOutputSeed
cases.description: outputSeed of one. Pins big-endian left-padding: an implementation that pads little-endian, or right-pads the value, puts the 0x01 byte in the wrong position and produces a different preimage.

cases.name: maxOutputSeed
cases.description: outputSeed of 2^256-1. Fails an implementation that parses the value through a double or any integer type narrower than 256 bits, which truncates or rounds before encoding.

cases.name: fullEntropyOutputSeed
cases.description: A realistic full-entropy outputSeed. The common path. Fails an implementation that uses index 1 rather than 0, or hashes the hex text of the value rather than its bytes.
